But even greater than the "Thundering Waters "of the Indians and the "Thunderer "at the White  House was the impression made upon me during the seven days I spent in the offices of Morgan  & Company. The firm at that time was still housed in the old low corner building on Wall Street.  The entire office was contained in a single room on the ground floor in which were dozens of  desks where the employees worked, a small room for the department heads being screened off  from the whole by glass halfway partitions. The long-drawn-out discussion of this material soon led to a certain  amount of exhaustion. Jack Morgan was the first to take a few days off which he spent cruising  in the Mediterranean in his yacht. But the other participants also felt the need of relaxation.
